data.name: Biswarup
data.gender_notes: Biswarup is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Biswa (universal) Rup (form). This name signifies the one who holds the form of the universe. The name Biswarup carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biswarup usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the infinite and hold the universe in your being.
data.etymology: Biswarup belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biswarup total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Biswarup carries a deep cultural significance in Hinduism. It is a name that reflects the expansive and eternal nature of the Divine. Biswarup implies that the bearer of this name holds the form of the universe within themselves. Historically, this name has been given to deities, kings, and spiritual leaders, who are believed to be erasers of distinctions and are all-encompassing.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Biswarup has great spiritual significance as it implies that the bearer of this name is a manifestation of the infinite Divine. The universal form of God is believed to contain all forms within it. This name can be considered as a reminder of our inherent divinity and the boundless nature of the Soul. It represents the ultimate Truth that we are not separate from the Divine but are an integral part of it. It inspires one to live with a sense of oneness, compassion, and love towards all beings and the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Biswarup, meaning 'Universal Form', symbolizes the infinite and all-encompassing nature of the divine. It embodies the idea that the supreme deity takes on various forms to pervade and nurture the entire universe.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Biswarup is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a king of the Vrishni clan. The name Biswarup carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name is associated with the mythology of the Vrishni clan and its connection to the Pandavas.

trends: increasing popularity as a given name in India
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Biswarup remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Biswarup, a teacher in Bangalore, India, shares that their name Biswarup meaning "Lord of the Universe" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
